3795.note_text: (1) Metrological confirmation normally includes calibration, any necessary adjustment or repair and subsequent recalibration, as well as any required sealing and labeling. (2) In this Document, this term is referred to as “confirmation”.

3793.note_text: set of operations required to ensure that an item of measuring and test equipment is in compliance with requirements for its intended use (see ISO 10012-1 [11])
